title: UseCallback
markdown: --- title: "UseCallback" --- > **Learn more:** [Hooks](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks), [Effects](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/effects) ## Overloads [#overloads] - [`UseCallback(Action, object[])`](#usecallbackaction-object) - [`UseCallback(Action, T1)`](#usecallbackt1action-t1) - [`UseCallback(Action, T1, T2)`](#usecallbackt1-t2action-t1-t2) - [`UseCallback(Action, T1, T2, T3)`](#usecallbackt1-t2-t3action-t1-t2-t3) ## `UseCallback(Action, object[])` [#usecallbackaction-object] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseCallback(System.Action,System.Object[])` ### Summary [#summary] Returns a stable callback reference that doesn't change between renders. ## `UseCallback(Action, T1)` [#usecallbackt1action-t1] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseCallback``1(System.Action,``0)` ### Summary [#summary_1] Single-dependency `UseCallback` overload that avoids the `params object[]` allocation (and value-type boxing) on the deps-unchanged path. Returns a stable reference until `d1` changes. ### Discussion [#discussion] If `d1`'s compile-time type is an array of reference types (e.g. `string[]`), it is treated as a dependency list and compared element-wise — matching the `params object[]` overload — not as a single reference-compared value. A dependency whose static type is not an array is always compared as one value, even if its runtime value happens to be an array. ## `UseCallback(Action, T1, T2)` [#usecallbackt1-t2action-t1-t2] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseCallback``2(System.Action,``0,``1)` ### Summary [#summary_2] Two-dependency `UseCallback` overload that avoids the `params object[]` allocation on the deps-unchanged path. ## `UseCallback(Action, T1, T2, T3)` [#usecallbackt1-t2-t3action-t1-t2-t3] `method` _cref_: `M:Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Core.RenderContext.UseCallback``3(System.Action,``0,``1,``2)` ### Summary [#summary_3] Three-dependency `UseCallback` overload that avoids the `params object[]` allocation on the deps-unchanged path. ## Featured in [#featured-in] - [Hooks](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks)
